onboarding.title: Your wallet, your keys
onboarding.point1: Keys are generated and stored only on this phone.
onboarding.point2: QvaPay never sees your secret phrase and can’t move your funds.
onboarding.point3: If you lose the 12-word phrase, nobody can recover it. Not even QvaPay.

backup.warning: Write it on paper, in order. Anyone with these 12 words controls your funds. Don’t keep it in screenshots or the clipboard.
backup.quizError: Not that one. Check your backup and start over.

settings.title: My wallet
settings.subtitle: Your keys live only on this phone.
settings.phraseHint: 12 words. Anyone who has them controls your funds. Shown only after verifying your identity.
settings.revealHint: Hides itself after 60 seconds or when you leave the app. Don’t take screenshots.
settings.revealFailed: Couldn’t read the phrase. Try again.
settings.notBackedUp: You haven’t confirmed your backup yet. Do it from the Crypto tab before receiving funds.
settings.deleteHint: Removes the wallet from this phone. Logging out does NOT remove it. Funds stay on-chain and can only be recovered with the phrase.

settings.confirmAck: I have my secret phrase saved
settings.noWallet: There’s no wallet on this phone.
settings.biometricsHint: As a PIN shortcut when sending and viewing the phrase. If you change your face or fingerprint, it asks for the PIN again.
settings.biometricsFailed: Couldn’t enable biometrics on this device.
